metadata.scope: Add admin CRUD endpoints for the tag master (tag_definitions) in apps/api: GET /admin/tags (pagination + search), POST /admin/tags (create, code conflict -> 409 tag_code_conflict), PATCH /admin/tags/:tagId (update label/category only; code immutable), DELETE /admin/tags/:tagId (logical delete active=0; existing member_tags rows preserved). Extend tagDefinitions repository with write functions, add audit actions admin.tag.created/updated/deactivated with new AuditTargetType 'tag', mount a new apps/api/src/routes/admin/tags.ts route, and re-document invariant #13 in specs/01-api-schema.md as a third (tag master) write path. No D1 schema migration is required (the active column already exists in migration 0002). No apps/web (admin UI drawer inline-create wiring) change in this cycle — that is outside issue #1035's acceptance criteria (all AC-1..AC-7 are API endpoints) and is recorded as a Phase 12 unassigned-task candidate.

Staging deploy/runtime smoke, commit, push, PR, and Issue state changes remain user-gated. Issue #1035 stays CLOSED.
metadata.issue_optimization_note: Issue #1035 / followup-002 spec leaves two design points open: (1) whether tag `code` is immutable or renameable, and (2) the assigned/available divergence after logical delete. Both are resolved here against the CURRENT code: (1) PATCH updates label/category only — `code` is IMMUTABLE (the UNIQUE column is treated as a stable external/admin identifier; rename is out of scope to avoid seed/UI drift, audit ambiguity, and 409 churn). (2) Logical delete sets active=0; existing member_tags rows are preserved; getTagDefinitionMaster / listAssignedTagsForMember already filter `td.active = 1` (members.ts available list), so a deactivated tag disappears from the available list while staying assigned — AC-7 regression is therefore satisfied with NO change to the existing GET /admin/members/:memberId/tags surface. The original issue body references invariant #13 as 'redefined' — but that 2026-05 redefinition (specs/01-api-schema.md:193-226, memberTags.ts:1-13) only opened member_tags write; the tag master (tag_definitions) is still read-only (tagDefinitions.ts:48 'write API は提供しない'). This task adds the THIRD write path (tag master CRUD) and updates both that code comment and the spec doc. AuditAction is RepoBrand<string> (no enum) so new action strings need no type change; only AuditTargetType (auditLog.ts:8-14) gains '| tag'. tagDefinitions.ts has NO readonly type-d gate (only memberTags.readonly.test-d.ts exists), so adding write functions there does not break a type gate.
